test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct sequence of states according to the given sequence of cultural festivals celebrated in the respected states.

Hampi Dance Utsav, Mamallapuram Dance Utsav, Nishagandhi Festival, Taj Mahotsav

options.text: Uttar Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka
Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, Uttar Pradesh
Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Uttar Pradesh
Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh

solution:
The correct answer is **'Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Uttar Pradesh'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Hampi Dance Utsav**

 
 
• The festival includes lighting up the prominent monuments in Hampi, Jumbo Saavari (elephant procession), and performances by some of India's most celebrated singers, dancers, and performers, water sports, food courts, photography competitions, Rangoli/ Mehndi competitions, etc.
 
 
 
• **Mamallapuram** **Dance** **Utsav**​
 
 
• ​The festival will be held at the Shore Temple in Mamallapuram from December 23rd, 2022, to January 12th, 2023. Get ready to experience the classical and folk-art cultures of Tamil Nadu.
 
 
 
• **Nishagandhi** **Festival**
 
 
• ​The Nishagandhi dance festival is organized by Kerala government, and it is a seven day long cultural fest which is usually conducted in the Nisha Gandhi auditorium which is situated within the premise of Kanakakkunnu Palace. The palace is known as the heart and soul of Trivandrum, and thus it is the apt location to plan the annual seven-day event amidst the verdant and green premise of Kanakakkunnu Palace.
 
 
 
• ​**Taj** **Mahotsav** 
 
 
• ​Taj Mahotsav Agra, one of the most eagerly awaited festivals, is celebrated from 18th to 27th February every year at Shilpgram near the Eastern gate of “Taj Mahal”.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​A **cultural festival** honours the customs of a particular group of people or location.​
 
• Festivals with a cultural focus can also help to maintain our **sense of community** and our shared cultural ties by educating guests about customs and traditions.
 
• They give us the** opportunity to share** in collective celebration of the characteristics that define our community, culture, and individuality.
